title: Evaluation of Arthroplasty Treatment
official: Evaluation in the Perioperative Course of Arthroplasty Treatment
summary: The aim of the study is to examine patients after knee and hip endoprosthesis in the longitudinal section and to evaluate the surgical outcome.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* There is an indication for primary knee or hip replacement or revision.
* The subject is over 18 years of age.
* Written consent is given if the subject is fully responsible.

Exclusion Criteria:

* A known pregnancy
* A known mental or pain-associated illness
* Illness of an airborne infectious disease with an increased risk of mortality and morbidity
* Patient intolerances or restrictions that make participation in the study impossible
